Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician performed paper bill slip test along all four gasket edges to identify gaps letting in humid air, confirming that warped and hardened magnetic door gasket that lost seal along the bottom corner. fridge/liebherr-refrigerator-repair-serv.heading: Liebherr Refrigerator Minor Refrigerant Gas Leak At Copper Joint in Cowley Brown Road
fridge/liebherr-refrigerator-repair-serv.body: In an established family household close to Forest College perimeter & quiet tree-lined homes in Cowley Brown Road, the customer reported that their Liebherr refrigerator encountered an issue where gradual loss of cooling over three weeks, with oily residue spotted on the compressor suction line. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician connected manifold pressure gauges, detected low standing pressure, and used electronic soap bubble leak testing, confirming that pinhole vibration crack on the service charging tube valve joint. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the copper filter drier and charging valve, brazed the cracked joint with silver alloy, installed a new molecular sieve filter drier, pulled deep vacuum to 500 microns, and charged exact R600a refrigerant by weight. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

fridge/liebherr-refrigerator-repair-serv.heading: Liebherr Refrigerator Continuous Compressor Running Without Shutoff in NSR Road

Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician tested 12V supply to the damper stepper motor, accessed air duct between compartments, confirming that motorized motorized air baffle damper flap stripped its miniature nylon gear, staying shut permanently. fridge/motorola-refrigerator-repair-serv.heading: Motorola Refrigerator Continuous Compressor Running Without Shutoff in Samichettipalayam
fridge/motorola-refrigerator-repair-serv.body: In an established family household close to Jothipuram link & suburban family residences in Samichettipalayam, the customer reported that their Motorola refrigerator encountered an issue where compressor running 24 hours without cutting off, freezing milk and curds in the lower refrigerator compartment. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician measured compartment temperature with a digital probe and monitored thermostat contact cycling over 45 minutes, confirming that capillary thermostat sensor bulb lost gas charge and could not open internal electrical contacts at set temperature. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician inspected defrost drain trough beneath the cooling coil, tested drain line with warm water injection, confirming that dust slime and algae clogging the internal defrost water drain hole and funnel above the compressor pan. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the defrost drain tube assembly, flushed and sanitized the drain line with pressurized nitrogen, cleared the compressor evaporation tray, and eliminated internal leaks. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

fridge/videocon-refrigerator-repair-serv.heading: Videocon Refrigerator Excessive Side Panel Heat And Low Cooling in Chitra Nagar
fridge/videocon-refrigerator-repair-serv.body: At an independent house near Aerodrome road residential streets in Chitra Nagar, the householder reported that their Videocon refrigerator encountered an issue where outer side cabinet walls burning hot to the touch while food inside was slowly spoiling. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician inspected bottom machinery compartment, cleared heavy dust blanket from spiral condenser tube, confirming that choked condenser coil and failed condenser fan motor at the bottom compressor compartment. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the condenser cooling fan motor, replaced seized 220V condenser fan motor, cleaned condenser coils thoroughly, and brought cabinet surface temperatures back to normal. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

fridge/videocon-refrigerator-repair-serv.heading: Videocon Refrigerator Continuous Compressor Running Without Shutoff in Anjugam Nagar
fridge/videocon-refrigerator-repair-serv.body: In a family apartment close to Vedampatti link & affordable housing colony in Anjugam Nagar, the client reported that their Videocon refrigerator encountered an issue where compressor running 24 hours without cutting off, freezing milk and curds in the lower refrigerator compartment. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician measured compartment temperature with a digital probe and monitored thermostat contact cycling over 45 minutes, confirming that capillary thermostat sensor bulb lost gas charge and could not open internal electrical contacts at set temperature. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the temperature control thermostat, replaced faulty mechanical thermostat with calibrated unit, verified auto-cutoff at 4°C in the food section. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

fridge/videocon-refrigerator-repair-serv.heading: Videocon Refrigerator Electronic Air Damper Motor Stuck Closed in Udayampalayam

Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician connected digital clamp ammeter and tested capacitor with capacitance meter at outdoor service panel, confirming that swollen dual run capacitor having dropped from 50 uF to 14 uF, causing compressor to overheat and trip on thermal overload. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the dual run capacitor, installed a high-temperature 50+5 uF metallized polypropylene capacitor, cleaned outdoor fin surface, and restored steady 12°C vent chill. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

servicecenter/akai-service-center-kanyak.heading: Akai LED TV Audio Clear But Black Display in Codissia Road
servicecenter/akai-service-center-kanyak.body: At a peaceful residential layout near Trade fair complex link & housing colonies in Codissia Road, the homeowner reported that their Akai led tv encountered an issue where television turned on with crisp dialogue and audio from channels, but screen stayed completely black. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

servicecenter/bajaj-service-center-coimb.heading: Bajaj Microwave Oven Indoor Temperature Sensor Drift in Town Hall
servicecenter/bajaj-service-center-coimb.body: At an independent house near Clock tower circle & heritage wholesale bazaar in Town Hall, the homeowner reported that their Bajaj microwave oven encountered an issue where AC chilling room like an icebox without ever cutting back compressor, ignoring remote set point. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician measured sensor resistance at 25°C water bath against standard temperature-resistance curve, confirming that room ambient temperature thermistor resistance drifted from 10k ohms down to 2.1k ohms due to moisture ingress. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the room ambient thermistor sensor, installed a factory-calibrated epoxy-coated thermistor sensor, verifying precise compressor cycling at user set temperature. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

servicecenter/bajaj-service-center-coimb.heading: Bajaj Microwave Oven Excessive Side Panel Heat And Low Cooling in Press Colony

Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician inspected bottom machinery compartment, cleared heavy dust blanket from spiral condenser tube, confirming that choked condenser coil and failed condenser fan motor at the bottom compressor compartment. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

servicecenter/bajaj-service-center-coimb.heading: Bajaj Microwave Oven Minor Refrigerant Gas Leak At Copper Joint in Ganapathy

Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician connected manifold pressure gauges, detected low standing pressure, and used electronic soap bubble leak testing, confirming that pinhole vibration crack on the service charging tube valve joint. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

servicecenter/bpl-service-center-coimbat.heading: BPL Microwave Oven HDMI Port No Signal After Surge in Chettipalayam Road

Upon detailed checking, the technician tested incoming water pressure from the overhead tank and measured electrical resistance across both solenoid coils with a multimeter, confirming that hard borewell mineral scaling choking the fine brass mesh filter of the dual water inlet solenoid valve. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the water inlet solenoid valve, descaled the inlet filter chamber, installed a fresh dual-coil solenoid valve, and verified rapid water intake within 4 minutes. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.heading: Whirlpool Washing Machine Drive Belt Slip And Agitation Stall in Maruthamalai Road
washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.body: In a multi-story home situated close to Temple approach avenue & university belt in Maruthamalai Road, the customer reported that their Whirlpool washing machine encountered an issue where motor hummed steadily but wash agitator pulsator failed to turn with a load of clothes inside. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician inspected belt deflection from the rear access panel and checked drive pulley alignment, confirming that stretched drive V-belt having lost tension and slipping around the motor pulley. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the drive motor V-belt, fitted a genuine reinforced V-belt, adjusted motor mount bracket tension, and tested vigorous agitation under full water load. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.heading: Whirlpool Washing Machine Touch Control Panel Unresponsive in Ranganathapuram
washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.body: At a peaceful residential layout near Sulur lake perimeter & residential quarters in Ranganathapuram, a local resident reported that their Whirlpool washing machine encountered an issue where power button turning on display lights but start/pause sensor not triggering program start. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician disassembled front user interface panel, dried contact pads, and tested conductive rubber contact traces, confirming that moisture penetration behind the capacitive touch ribbon cable from high utility room humidity. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the display UI touch control panel, cleaned and sealed touch sensor contacts with moisture-resistant lacquer, restoring crisp touch response. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.heading: Whirlpool Washing Machine Electronic PCB Cycle Halt in Thudiyalur
washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.body: In a residential cross street around Mettupalayam Road transit hub & family layouts in Thudiyalur, the family reported that their Whirlpool washing machine encountered an issue where machine abruptly cutting off power and resetting program exactly at the rinse rinse stage. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician inspected circuit board under magnification for swollen capacitors, tested output voltages, and verified grounding, confirming that voltage fluctuation damaging the power supply capacitor and motor triac circuit on the main inverter PCB. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the inverter control PCB module, repaired damaged micro-components on the power rail, re-soldered dry joints, and verified seamless wash, rinse, and spin sequencing. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.heading: Whirlpool Washing Machine Excessive Motor Bearing Noise in Kalveerampalayam
washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.body: At an independent house near Maruthamalai main road & peaceful residences in Kalveerampalayam, the householder reported that their Whirlpool washing machine encountered an issue where harsh metallic screeching sound growing louder as drum accelerated into the intermediate spin cycle. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician checked radial play in the stainless steel drum shaft and rotated the drum manually to pinpoint bearing rumble, confirming that degraded tub water seal permitting moisture seepage into the double rear ball bearings, causing rust pitting. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the drum bearings and rubber water seal, extracted worn rear bearings with a hydraulic puller, pressed in fresh precision sealed bearings with a silicone seal, and restored whisper-quiet rotation. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.heading: Whirlpool Washing Machine Detergent Tray Leakage in Vadavalli Road
washing-machine/whirlpool-washing-machin.body: In a family apartment close to RS Puram to Vadavalli transit & shopping avenue in Vadavalli Road, the client reported that their Whirlpool washing machine encountered an issue where soapy water trickling down the front cabinet panel from the soap dispenser during initial wash fill. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician pulled out the dispenser drawer, inspected spray jets under the top cover, and checked siphon tube clearance, confirming that heavy detergent residue buildup and hardened lime scale deflecting the high-pressure water spray nozzles inside the dispenser housing. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the detergent dispenser siphon assembly, thoroughly cleared the calcified spray channels, reseated the dispenser gasket, and completed a leak-free wash test. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.heading: White Westinghouse Washing Machine Drum Pulsator Stripped in Press Colony
washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.body: In a family apartment close to Government press township & family housing in Press Colony, the family reported that their White Westinghouse washing machine encountered an issue where wash pulsator plate spinning freely on the metal spline without turning the clothes. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician unscrewed center cap, removed retaining bolt, and inspected matching splines on drive shaft and pulsator, confirming that worn internal plastic spline teeth inside the pulsator hub due to overloading. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the wash pulsator plate assembly, fitted a durable replacement pulsator plate with reinforced metal insert, ensuring strong dual-direction water turnover. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.heading: White Westinghouse Washing Machine Intermittent Drain Failure in Bharathi Nagar (Ganapathy)
washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.body: At a residential villa located near Sathy Road residential colony & school street in Bharathi Nagar (Ganapathy), the householder reported that their White Westinghouse washing machine encountered an issue where washing machine halted mid-cycle with water remaining trapped inside the wash tub, flashing an OE drain fault. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician opened the bottom emergency drain plug, drained out trapped soapy water, and dismantled the drain pump casing to inspect the rotor, confirming that safety pins and coin debris lodged within the drain pump filter chamber, jamming the centrifugal impeller blades. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the drain pump assembly, cleared the clogged lint trap, replaced the damaged impeller housing, and tested complete drainage across two quick spin cycles. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.heading: White Westinghouse Washing Machine Water Leaking From Tub Bellows in Periya Vedampatti
washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.body: In a duplex home situated around Agricultural perimeter & serene family houses in Periya Vedampatti, the client reported that their White Westinghouse washing machine encountered an issue where clean water pooling under front of machine during wash tumbling. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician inspected folds of the rubber door boot gasket under strong LED light to locate the tear, confirming that small puncture in the front door rubber bellow gasket caused by an entrapped zipper tooth. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the door boot gasket bellow, installed a factory-spec rubber door seal with front and rear tension clamps, verifying zero seepage during a 60-degree wash. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.heading: White Westinghouse Washing Machine Violent Spin Vibration in Raja Street
washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.body: At a textile business residence near Koniamman temple square & heritage shopping lanes in Raja Street, the homeowner reported that their White Westinghouse washing machine encountered an issue where washer shaking violently and moving across the utility room tiles during high-speed 1000 RPM extraction. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician removed top and rear cabinet panels, measured damping resistance on each suspension strut, and leveled the machine base, confirming that uneven wear on hydraulic suspension damper rods and degraded tub balancing springs. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the suspension damper struts, fitted four matched heavy-duty suspension rods, adjusted front leveling feet, and ran a full spin test with a balanced load. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.

washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.heading: White Westinghouse Washing Machine Unbalance Sensor Tripping in Ravathur
washing-machine/white-westinghouse-washi.body: In an established family household close to Irugur-Sulur rural belt & family dwellings in Ravathur, the customer reported that their White Westinghouse washing machine encountered an issue where top load washer stopping repeatedly during spin and continually refilling water in an endless loop. Our local Coimbatore technician visited the home equipped with essential testing instruments. Upon detailed checking, the technician tested air pressure hose for pinhole cracks and measured transducer frequency output on the control board, confirming that faulty electronic pressure transducer sensor misreading tub balance and water level signals. With the customer's approval on the repair estimate, the technician replaced the water level pressure sensor, replaced the perished pressure hose, installed a fresh level sensor, and verified smooth single-pass spin extraction. The appliance resumed normal operation immediately, leaving the household completely satisfied.
